summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan addressing:
1. Search loading timeout & graceful error state (fixing infinite spinner).
2. Deletable downloaded songs with individual deletion & bulk clear actions, replacing all 'cached' naming.
3. Complete removal of pre-made playlists, starting new playlists as empty.
4. Robust Playlist Management: Add to playlist, Remove from playlist, Move songs between playlists.
5. Online vs Offline Playlists with auto-download for offline playlists.
6. Authentic, distinct high-resolution album covers across all songs, eliminating duplicate placeholder images, plus proper loading indicators.
7. Fresh, diverse initial catalog for Home screen on first start.
8. Admin panel feature controls for all new & updated features.
